输出 contractVersion=2。你是游戏行业简报编辑；事件事实仅来自已打开的 packet 证据。对 packages 和 trackingQueue 每个 eventKey 恰好给一个 include/exclude/needs_review。needs_review 必须 tracking=true；跟踪项无新证据也须明确继续或关闭，关闭时 tracking=false 且 reason 写依据。

若 packet.continuation.scope=news，这是受信的同一期有界续接包：只处理本包 packages/trackingQueue，保留已发布正文、标题、头条和 issue/window，不提交 upcoming 变更，不添加 showcaseRefs、其他批次或窗口外事实。若 scope=showcase，严格按 scoped announcement/fact 身份补齐，不把普通新闻混入，也不因部分材料或 Highlights 声称完整。
lane=interviews、features、industry、reviews、awards 可按文章/采访/评测/分析/奖项信息本身首次发布的时间准入，但必须有明确的信息增量（首次披露、独立采访、调查、技术/产业分析、正式评分或奖项变化）。普通观点、推荐、促销软文、无新增信息的旧闻复述仍应 exclude。不得把窗口外旧事件伪装成窗口内 breaking news；标题摘要须体现本次新增内容。

游戏工作室并购后超六成出现不同程度发展问题
389家游戏工作室并购调查：34%关停，腾讯收购后50%表现不佳，网易为33%
过去十多年，游戏行业经历了数轮大规模并购。对于大型游戏公司而言，收购一家成熟工作室，意味着可以快速获得开发团队、成熟IP、技术积累以及进入新市场的机会。相比从零开始建立研发团队，直接收购似乎是一条更高效的扩张路径。
近日，游戏行业研究项目Game Studio Unlocked发布了一份关于游戏工作室并购后命运的调查报告。报告对2000年以来大型及中型游戏公司收购的389家PC、主机游戏工作室进行了调查，试图回答一个问题：当一家工作室成为大型游戏集团的一部分，它最终会变得更强大，还是逐渐失去原有的创造力？
研究结果并不乐观。在359家游戏开发工作室中，122家最终关停，占比34%；另有96家被归类为表现下降。也就是说， 60.7%的被收购工作室在作品表现或组织存续方面出现了不同程度的问题。
而在这份名单中，既有EA、微软、索尼等传统游戏巨头，也有腾讯、网易等近年来积极拓展海外研发版图的中国厂商。

packages.headline: EA Adds 'Don't Delete' Message to Madden NFL 27 in Bid to Keep Players From Making Room Ahead of GTA 6

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
EA has added a "don't delete" pop-up message to Madden NFL 27, and players can't help but feel the company is begging them not to make room for Grand Theft Auto 6.
EA Adds 'Don't Delete' Message to Madden NFL 27 in Bid to Keep Players From Making Room Ahead of GTA 6
Reports of the new in-game notice began cropping up over the weekend, with CharlieIntel relaying their findings online. EA doesn't explicitly mention GTA 6 in the new message, but considering the pop-up features some familiar pink-and-purple colors and sun-kissed palm trees, it's pretty easy to put two and two together.
EA has added a 'Don't Delete!' message to EA Madden NFL 27 ahead of Grand Theft Auto VI's launch The in-game ad says there's an update on Nov 17 for the title, before GTA VI https://t.co/P00NPUVveK
There's just no getting around it; the next week is going to be very, very weird for the gaming industry. GTA 6, a decade-in-the-making video game said to bring the biggest launch of all time , has mostly seen every other game clear the calendar just to make room for it. The atmosphere surrounding Rockstar Games' latest is something to behold, and with millions of players still turning up for live-service titles, one can wonder if any of their developers are worried about GTA 6 taking a chunk of their attention.
That at least seems to be the case for EA and Madden NFL 27. If a Vice City-themed pop-up in this year's annual football game release wasn't enough to convince you, its official X/Twitter account actually recently doubled down. A November 10 post promoting a November 18 update referenced GTA 6's massive file size by saying, "Don't let 210GB get between you and Your League."
When one Reddit user asked what the message was related to, one user replied , "It means that EA is terrified of GTA VI's launch." Another said it felt like the pop-up was the publisher's way of saying, "'PLEASE DON'T DELETE MADDEN TO CLEAR SPACE FOR GTA. PLEASE PLEASE PLEASE!'"
"Respectfully I might never play your game again after GTA comes out," another added .
@EAMaddenNFL Just deleted madden to create more space for my GTA6 https://t.co/qLUsaG9604
EA has added a "don't delete" pop-up message to Madden NFL 27 , and players can't help but feel the company is begging them not to make room for Grand Theft Auto 6 .
The message encourages Madden NFL 27 users to refrain from uninstalling the game from their devices, promising that those who stick around can look forward to a new update coming Tuesday, November 17. It's a bit beside the point, but we should also mention that, at least based on early screenshots, EA's message includes a typo, writing "awating signal" instead of "awaiting signal." Newer posts suggest it was fixed pretty quickly. Whoops!

packages.headline: GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Will Start as Small-Time Criminals Who Have to Work Up to High-Value Jobs

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
GTA 6 will let Jason and Lucia pull off high-value jobs, but Rockstar Games asks players to work up from being small-time criminals first.
GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Will Start as Small-Time Criminals Who Have to Work Up to High-Value Jobs
The latest peek at this week's new Grand Theft Auto game arrived courtesy of a preview piece from The Guardian (via @GameRoll_ ). It included interviews with Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson and head of publishing Jennifer Kolbe, who covered the kind of people GTA 6 will cater to and the kind of people it's about.
Jason and Lucia are two names we've heard for years, and they're not about to go away any time soon. After 13 years, faithful GTA fans will soon finally go hands-on with the next mainline game in the groundbreaking open-world sandbox series. They won't be able to immediately pull off front-page heists out of the gate, though.
The Guardian said players won't be allowed to have the duo rob Vice City jewelry stores or drive around Leonida in sports cars in the early moments of GTA 6. Instead, they'll only be able to "hotwire low-end vehicles and pick basic locks" until they work their way up to high-value work later. What the threshold to reach those moments is remains unclear, but considering Rockstar has toiled away on the game for more than a decade, it's probably best that players don't burn their way to the top too quickly.
Nelson described the "younger couple" as a pair with "their backs against the wall" when we first meet them. We've known that GTA 6 takes after Red Dead Redemption 2 in some respects, so Jason and Lucia won't be whipping out RPGs from their back pocket – at least at first. The piece added that robbing everything from gas stations to upscale mall boutiques might be easier or more fruitful if players take the time to complete extra steps. That might mean disabling security cameras or stealing surveillance footage, or it could mean scoping out locations for more discreet entry points.
A more detailed and realistic world line with another new element Rockstar accounted for: empathy . As detailed by The Guardian, Nelson and the rest of the team have promised that GTA 6 includes "mechanisms for encouraging" empathy for the first time in series history. What exactly that means remains to be seen, but with many details and different ways to play, we probably won't fully understand the developers' vision until we meet Jason and Lucia ourselves.
GTA 6 launches for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S November 19. For more, you can check out IGN's preview from earlier this year. You can also check out the recent leak that spilled the full track list for the game's official album , and why we're excited to jump into Vice City, even if it's at 30 fps .

packages.headline: NVIDIAの新技術「DLSS 5」を『ホグワーツ・レガシー』で体験。AIが見慣れた景色をフォトリアルに“味変”

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
先日DLSS 5に対応した『ホグワーツ・レガシー』で、オン・オフを切り替えながら校内や屋外を歩き回った。
NVIDIAの新技術「DLSS 5」を『ホグワーツ・レガシー』で体験。AIが見慣れた景色をフォトリアルに“味変”
そこで今回は、先日DLSS 5に対応した『ホグワーツ・レガシー』で、オン・オフを切り替えながら校内や屋外を歩き回った。まず確かめたかったのは、見慣れた先生や生徒たちの顔がどう映るのか。ところが、いざ遊び始めると、逆光を受けた髪や、暗がりで光が当たる石柱など、思いのほか顔以外のところで足を止めることになった。本稿では、光や質感の変化がホグワーツの印象をどう変えたのか、フレームレートや操作感への影響も併せて紹介する。
PC版『ホグワーツ・レガシー』には、11月5日のアップデートで「ニューラルレンダリング」という設定項目が加わった。これをオンにすると、DLSS 5を適用した画面で遊べる。現時点では、GeForce RTX 50シリーズ搭載のデスクトップPCおよびノートPC、RTX Spark搭載PCのほか、クラウドゲーミングサービスのGeForce NOW Ultimateが対応している。
また、その仕上がりにはゲーム制作者の調整も反映される。『ホグワーツ・レガシー』でも開発元のAvalanche SoftwareがNVIDIAと協力し、元の表現意図を保つため、環境や色調、肌に関するパラメーターを調整したという。今回確認するのは、そうした調整を経た「本作におけるDLSS 5」の仕上がりだ。
歩いていて印象に残ったのは、くっきりして彩度が落ち、ホグワーツを包む空気がいくらか冷たくなったことだ。映画でいうと、『ハリー・ポッター』から『ファンタスティック・ビースト』へ移ったときの感覚に近い。同じ魔法界でも、建物や雰囲気が大人びている。
今後『ホグワーツ・レガシー』を遊ぶとき、筆者は基本的にニューラルレンダリングをオンにしておきたい。なかでも気に入ったのは、髪の毛などの細部に宿る説得力だ。緊張感のある洞窟では、暗がりに浮かぶ服の質感やルーモスの明かりがとくに映える。より写実的になったホグワーツには、もう少しこのまま歩いてみたいと思わせる新鮮さがあった。
一方、魔法学校に転入したばかりという、少し浮き立つようなストーリーには、元の明るさがよく似合うとも思う。会話相手の表情を朗らかに見せる明かりや、城内を歩くときの柔らかな色合いも、元のホグワーツが持っていたよさだ。暗い地下ならオンで眺めたいし、人と話すなら元の明かりも捨てがたい。どちらのホグワーツを歩きたいかは案外好みの分かれるところで、筆者にとっては、見慣れた世界のちょっとした“味変”に収まっていた。
NVIDIAの「DLSS 5」は、生成AIを用いてゲーム映像の光や素材の見え方を変える新技術だ。今年3月の発表時には、キャラクターの顔立ちまで大きく変わって見える映像が話題となり、作品本来の表現が損なわれないかと懸念する声も上がった。筆者も、その変化の大きさが気になっていたひとりである。
